name: acad-modify
description: AutoCAD entity edit and transform operations: rigid transforms (move, rotate, scale, mirror, align two-point), copy and array (rectangular and polar), erase, undo / redo, common-property updates (layer, color, linetype, lineweight) including bulk match-properties from a source entity, and AutoCAD Group management (create / add / remove / rename / dissolve / list members). All operations require the AcadMcp .NET plugin loaded inside an open AutoCAD session and run inside a single transaction with a document lock so the AutoCAD UI stays consistent.
intent_examples: array entities by rows and cols

tools_summary.name: align
tools_summary.description: Align entities so that source point pair (A,B) maps onto target point pair (A,B). Optional uniform scale to make distances match.

tools_summary.name: array_polar
tools_summary.description: Polar (circular) array around a center, distributing N items over the given total angle. Optionally rotate items along the path.

tools_summary.name: array_rectangular
tools_summary.description: Rectangular array (rows × cols × levels) by row, column and optional Z level spacing.
intent: array entities by rows and cols

tools_summary.name: copy
tools_summary.description: Copy entities by translation from→to. Set count > 1 for an evenly stepped chain of copies.

tools_summary.name: create_group
tools_summary.description: Create a named AutoCAD Group containing the given entities. Selectable=true makes the group pickable as a unit.

tools_summary.name: erase
tools_summary.description: Erase entities (soft delete – AutoCAD keeps them in the undo stack until purged).

tools_summary.name: match_properties
tools_summary.description: Copy generic properties (layer, color, linetype, lineweight, ltscale) from source entity onto target entities.

tools_summary.name: mirror
tools_summary.description: Mirror entities through a plane defined by point + normal (3D); optionally erase the source entities.

tools_summary.name: move
tools_summary.description: Translate one or more entities by the vector from→to (WCS).

tools_summary.name: rotate
tools_summary.description: Rotate entities around a center by angle (degrees, CCW). Optional axis vector for 3D rotations (default Z).

tools_summary.name: scale
tools_summary.description: Uniformly scale entities about a center point by a positive factor.

tools_summary.name: set_color
tools_summary.description: Set the entity color to a true RGB color or an ACI index (1..255).

tools_summary.name: set_layer
tools_summary.description: Move entities to the given layer (creates the layer if missing).

tools_summary.name: set_linetype
tools_summary.description: Set the linetype (by name) and optional linetype scale on entities. The linetype must already be loaded.

tools_summary.name: set_lineweight
tools_summary.description: Set entity lineweight in millimeters. Common values: 0.13, 0.18, 0.25, 0.5, 0.7, 1.0 mm.

tools_summary.name: ungroup
tools_summary.description: Delete a named Group (the underlying entities remain in the drawing).
